messages.author: bf0b1dcf5e0e8037
messages.subject: axis segment breaks
parts:
I would like to introduce segment breaks into the x-axis of a plot I
have generated. The x-axis is a continuous scale, say,
c(-1000:1000). I would like to have the left segment of the scale be
c(-1000:-500) and occupy only say, 5% of the physical length of the x-
axis, and then have the right segment occupy the remaining 95% of the
x-axis length with the range c(100:1000). Often you see these plots
with a break denoted as "-/ /-". Can anyone assist me here?

Thanks so much, Joel

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: axis segment breaks
parts:
Hi Joel,

This is not currently possible in ggplot2. I'm ambivalent about this
type of display. You can get something very similar with facetting if
you really want to do it.

Hadley

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: axis segment breaks
parts:
Hi:

I tend to agree with Hadley about the wisdom of using breaks in a plot, but there is a function to do this sort of thing in the plotrix package.

RSiteSearch('break plot axis')

scared up the function axis.break() in plotrix as the first hit. I presume it's meant for base graphics, though.

HTH,
Dennis
